description:
Alpha Hub is an early-stage fintech startup aiming to transform private capital markets through AI and blockchain technology. They are seeking a Content Creator to produce engaging content across various platforms to enhance brand authority and support marketing efforts.

Write and update website copy, landing pages, and blog articles optimized for search to drive traffic and establish thought leadership

Develop posts and articles that build brand authority and engage startup founders and investor audiences

Write campaign copy, newsletters, and drip sequences that nurture leads and support conversion goals

Draft platform-appropriate content aligned with our brand voice and editorial calendar

Support the creation of pitch decks, one-pagers, internal documents, research papers, and other collateral for internal and external audiences

Write interface copy, help center articles, FAQs, and onboarding guides that make the Alpha Hub platform easy to use
job_summary: Alpha Hub is an early-stage fintech startup aiming to transform private capital markets through AI and blockchain technology. They are seeking a Content Creator to produce engaging content across various platforms to enhance brand authority and support marketing efforts.

mustHave: 3+ years of professional content creation experience across digital marketing, or technical writing
Proven ability to write across multiple formats — articles, emails, social copy, and sales materials
Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals (on-page optimization, keyword intent, content structure)
Strong research skills with the ability to translate complex financial topics into clear, engaging content
Collaborative, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote startup environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
preferredHave: Access to and working knowledge of AI-assisted content tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and creative software (Adobe Creative Cloud)
Experience with email marketing or CRM platforms
Familiarity with analytics or SEO tools (Ahrefs, Google Search Console, etc.)
Prior experience in capital markets, private equity, or venture capital
Graphic design and video editing ability

core_responsibilities: Write and update website copy, landing pages, and blog articles optimized for search to drive traffic and establish thought leadership
Develop posts and articles that build brand authority and engage startup founders and investor audiences
Write campaign copy, newsletters, and drip sequences that nurture leads and support conversion goals
Draft platform-appropriate content aligned with our brand voice and editorial calendar
Support the creation of pitch decks, one-pagers, internal documents, research papers, and other collateral for internal and external audiences
Write interface copy, help center articles, FAQs, and onboarding guides that make the Alpha Hub platform easy to use
